verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own IP Litigation page describes a dedicated team of more than 80 litigators and lead-counsel roles in hundreds of Patent Trial and Appeal Board matters, which names a venue. Its practice pages also cover trademark litigation and a trade secrets practice, so all three dispute types are addressed on first-party pages. Missing for 10: named courts (e.g., district courts, ITC, Federal Circuit), specific case outcomes or wins, any detail on trademark or trade-secret venues, and independent corroboration.
